title: auth.user_projection
description: Pull half of the user projection: answers a user's projection by id so a consumer can mirror the row on first contact through get_or_create_user_from_jwt. Returns {found: bool, user?: {...}} — user, when present, is exactly serialize_user_to_jwt_data(user), the same claim payload user.created/user.updated carry. found=false for an unknown id, an id an erasure has since deleted, or a malformed id (never raises). A deactivated account still has a row and comes back found=true with is_active=false in the payload — the caller's own gate decides what that means.

user_id.description: Primary key of the user whose projection is read.
